dialect.detail: Micro Focus Object COBOL / NetExpress or similar OO COBOL with Java interop via REPOSITORY CLASS declarations and :> method invocation syntax. Likely part of the PRAGMA [FM] framework interfacing with a Jasper Reports web service client (FdsJSClient).

purpose.domain_detail: Jasper Reports web service client wrapper — sends report parameters (strings, numbers, dates, collections) to a Jasper Server via a Java-based web service client class (FdsJSClient/jswsc).
purpose.summary: This subprogram (FDSJSC) acts as a COBOL wrapper around a Java-based Jasper Reports web service client. It accepts report parameters of various types (single values and collections of strings, numbers, dates, decimals) via a linkage section, packages them into a Java Vector, and invokes the FdsJSClient to run the report. It returns a status code indicating success or failure.

notable_features: OO COBOL with REPOSITORY CLASS declarations mapping to Java classes
Interop with java.util.Vector, java.lang.String, java.text.SimpleDateFormat, java.lang.Long
Heavy use of COPY statements (11 copybooks)
EVALUATE TRUE with OO condition names
verdict.notes: This is clearly Micro Focus OO COBOL (likely NetExpress or later) with Java interoperability. The PRAGMA [FM] author tag and Italian-style naming (tabelle, stampa, fdtb) suggest an Italian software house. The program is a production-quality subprogram within a larger framework. Date written 1997 but OO features suggest a later revision or a late-1990s Micro Focus product.
